rubric: Targets are actionable supported findings or bounded evidence gaps, not necessarily product bugs. TP/miss use adjudicated finding-to-target matches; false positives are definite unsupported defect/test demands; unsupported claims include safety/execution assertions. Format omissions alone are not substantive FP. Evidence fidelity denominators include only assessable explicit citations/head/execution statements. Allowed row states describe dominant condition, not exhaustive consumer states.

targets.host-gap: minimum host and Node runtime need actual verification; types alone not proof

targets.compile-lint-gap: coupled major toolchain needs compile/lint/peer evidence

targets.restore-blocked: feed auth prerequisite blockage, not incompatibility

targets.lock-drift: current-head compiler generated actual lock drift

targets.policy-unknown: allow-list not confirmed; no confirmed violation

targets.resolution-mismatch: selector/lock coherence discrepancy; no affected advisory established

targets.traversal: B decoded traversal violates stated scope; A encoded package scope is allowed

targets.redis-skipped: Redis selected but skipped, template actually exercised
